outcomes.sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS total_ad_spend
FROM ads_campaign_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  c.channel,
  ROUND(SUM(acd.attributed_sales_14d) / NULLIF(SUM(acd.cost), 0), 2) AS roas
FROM ads_campaign_daily acd
JOIN campaigns c ON acd.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
WHERE acd.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  AND c.channel IN ('search', 'display')
GROUP BY c.channel
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(revenue_gross), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM shop_orders_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

WITH daily_returns AS (
  SELECT
    p.category,
    SUM(s.units_returned) AS total_returned,
    SUM(s.units_ordered) AS total_ordered
  FROM shop_orders_daily s
  JOIN products p ON s.sku = p.sku
  WHERE s.date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT
  category,
  total_returned,
  total_ordered,
  ROUND(100.0 * total_returned / NULLIF(total_ordered, 0), 2) AS return_rate_percent
FROM daily_returns
ORDER BY return_rate_percent DESC
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT 
  c.campaign_name,
  SUM(acd.clicks) as total_clicks
FROM ads_campaign_daily acd
JOIN campaigns c ON acd.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
WHERE acd.date BETWEEN '2026-09-14' AND '2026-09-20'
GROUP BY c.campaign_name
ORDER BY total_clicks DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  ROUND(
    SUM(purchases) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0),
    2
  ) AS conversion_rate_percent
FROM web_sessions_daily
WHERE
  channel = 'paid search'
  AND date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(sessions), 2) AS avg_sessions_per_day
FROM web_sessions_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(clicks) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(impressions), 0), 2) AS ctr_percent
FROM ads_campaign_daily acd
JOIN campaigns c ON acd.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
WHERE c.channel = 'display'
  AND acd.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT SUM(so.units_ordered) as total_units_ordered
FROM shop_orders_daily so
JOIN products p ON so.sku = p.sku
WHERE p.category = 'Running'
AND so.date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-27'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(cost) / NULLIF(SUM(attributed_orders_14d), 0), 2) AS cost_per_attributed_order
FROM ads_campaign_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS total_ad_spend
FROM ads_campaign_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  c.channel,
  ROUND(SUM(acd.attributed_sales_14d) / NULLIF(SUM(acd.cost), 0), 2) AS roas
FROM ads_campaign_daily acd
JOIN campaigns c ON acd.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
WHERE acd.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
GROUP BY c.channel
LIMIT 1000;

WITH august_2026 AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(revenue_gross) as gross_revenue,
    SUM(units_returned * p.list_price) as return_value
  FROM shop_orders_daily s
  LEFT JOIN products p ON s.sku = p.sku
  WHERE s.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(gross_revenue - COALESCE(return_value, 0), 2) as net_revenue
FROM august_2026
LIMIT 1000;

WITH product_returns AS (
  SELECT
    p.category,
    SUM(sd.units_returned) AS total_returned,
    SUM(sd.units_ordered) AS total_ordered
  FROM shop_orders_daily sd
  JOIN products p ON sd.sku = p.sku
  WHERE sd.date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT
  category,
  total_returned,
  total_ordered,
  ROUND(100.0 * total_returned / NULLIF(total_ordered, 0), 2) AS return_rate_percent
FROM product_returns
ORDER BY return_rate_percent DESC
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT 
  c.campaign_id,
  c.campaign_name,
  SUM(a.clicks) as total_clicks
FROM ads_campaign_daily a
JOIN campaigns c ON a.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
WHERE a.date BETWEEN '2026-09-14' AND '2026-09-20'
GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name
ORDER BY total_clicks DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  ROUND(
    SUM(purchases)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0) * 100,
    2
  ) AS conversion_rate_percent
FROM web_sessions_daily
WHERE channel = 'search'
  AND date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(sessions), 2) AS avg_sessions_per_day
FROM web_sessions_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(c.clicks)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(c.impressions), 0), 4) AS ctr
FROM ads_campaign_daily c
JOIN campaigns cam ON c.campaign_id = cam.campaign_id
WHERE cam.channel = 'display'
  AND c.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  SUM(so.units_ordered) AS total_units_ordered
FROM shop_orders_daily so
JOIN products p ON so.sku = p.sku
WHERE p.category = 'Running'
  AND so.date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-27'
LIMIT 1000;

WITH august_data AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(cost) AS total_cost,
    SUM(attributed_orders_14d) AS total_attributed_orders
  FROM ads_campaign_daily
  WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(total_cost / NULLIF(total_attributed_orders, 0), 2) AS cost_per_attributed_order
FROM august_data
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost) / 100, 2) AS total_ad_spend_eur
FROM ads_campaign_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000

SELECT c.channel,
       ROUND(SUM(a.cost) / 100, 2) AS spend_eur,
       ROUND(SUM(a.attributed_sales_14d), 2) AS attributed_sales_eur,
       ROUND(SUM(a.attributed_sales_14d) / NULLIF(SUM(a.cost) / 100, 0), 2) AS roas
FROM ads_campaign_daily a
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
WHERE a.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
GROUP BY c.channel
ORDER BY channel
LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue_gross) / 1.19, 2) AS net_revenue_eur
FROM shop_orders_daily
WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000

SELECT p.category,
       ROUND(SUM(s.units_returned) / NULLIF(SUM(s.units_ordered), 0), 4) AS return_rate
FROM shop_orders_daily s
JOIN products p ON p.sku = s.sku
WHERE s.date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY return_rate DESC
LIMIT 1000

SELECT c.campaign_name,
       SUM(a.clicks) AS total_clicks
FROM ads_campaign_daily a
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
WHERE a.date BETWEEN '2026-09-14' AND '2026-09-20'
GROUP BY c.campaign_name
ORDER BY total_clicks DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT ROUND(SUM(purchases) / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0), 4) AS conversion_rate
FROM web_sessions_daily
WHERE channel = 'paid_search'
  AND date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000

WITH daily_totals AS (
  SELECT date,
         SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions
  FROM web_sessions_daily
  WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY date
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_sessions), 2) AS avg_sessions_per_day
FROM daily_totals
LIMIT 1000

SELECT 
  ROUND(SUM(a.clicks) / NULLIF(SUM(a.impressions), 0), 4) AS ctr
FROM ads_campaign_daily a
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
WHERE c.channel = 'display'
  AND a.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.units_ordered), 0) AS units_ordered
FROM shop_orders_daily s
JOIN products p ON p.sku = s.sku
WHERE s.date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-27'
  AND p.category = 'Running'
LIMIT 1000

SELECT
  ROUND(
    (SUM(a.cost) / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(a.attributed_orders_14d), 0),
    2
  ) AS cost_per_attributed_order
FROM ads_campaign_daily a
WHERE a.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
LIMIT 1000
